release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.6 unifies the product around one Obsidian Black visual system. Legacy blue theme values and module-specific blue skins can no longer create mismatched panels: Updates, Tachyon Network, owner/admin and authority controls, top search, shutdown controls, navigation, command surfaces, cards, inputs and tab internals now share black/graphite surfaces with white/gray hierarchy. Decorative blue gradients, glows and graphics are neutralized; restrained green/red remain only where they communicate semantic success or destructive state. Existing routes, controls, task behavior, retailer flows, updater behavior and persistence are unchanged. The exact final main build passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E, CodeQL, Private Core CI, real Chromium E2E and the 120-task browser soak.
